notes: House incumbent mapping refers to current 119th Congress districts, not necessarily 2026 candidate/district alignment after redistricting.

special means November 2026 Senate special election for unexpired class III term (FL/OH); House records represent regular full-term 2026 contests, not a history of prior special elections. House FL20/TX23 vacancies have special-election date TBD on Clerk page.
Senate independents retain I currentParty and D caucus; House Kiley retains I currentParty and R caucus.
forecast null means no forecast joined or verified, not toss-up.
All 435 voting House districts retained; six delegates/resident commissioner excluded.
